wargear.name: Holo Field
wargear.text: A model with this wargear gains a 4+ Invulnerable save.

wargear.name: Flip Belt
wargear.text: A model equipped with this wargear gains the Fly and Move Through Cover special rules.

wargear.name: Mirage Mask
wargear.text: A model equipped with this wargear has the Fear (1) special rule.

wargear.name: Melta Bomb
wargear.text: In combat, a model with this wargear may forgo its attacks and instead make a single Strength 8, AP1 attack with the Melta Special rule at Initiative step 1.

wargear.name: Light Weight Plating
wargear.text: Light Weight Plating used in many Eldar vehicles. It confers a 3+ Armour save.

wargear.name: Wraithbone Plate
wargear.text: A living heavy organic armour plate. Confers a 2+ armour save.

wargear.name: Skyweaver Jetbike
wargear.text: A model that is equipped with Jetbike becomes the Jetbike type. The Jetbike increases the model's Toughness (T) by 1. The Jetbike is equipped with a Shuriken Cannon.

wargear.name: Jetbike
wargear.text: A model that is equipped with Jetbike becomes the Jetbike type. The Jetbike increases the model's Toughness (T) by 1. The Jetbike is equipped with a Linked Shuriken Catapult.

wargear.name: Vectored Engines
wargear.text: A model with this wargear gains the Deep Strike special rule.

wargear.name: Star Engines
wargear.text: Increase a model with this wargear's Movement (M) characteristic by 2".

wargear.name: Starmist Raiment
wargear.text: One unit in your army with the Character special rule that does not have the Unique keyword and no other Relic Wargear may purchase this wargear. All Attacks against a model bearing this Relic are resolved as if the Attacking model is affected by the Blind special rule.

wargear.name: The Laughing God's Eye
wargear.text: One unit in your army with the Character special rule that does not have the Unique keyword and no other Relic Wargear may purchase this wargear. A model with this Wargear and any attached unit gain the Adamantium Will and Deny the Witch special rules.

wargear.name: The Mask of Secrets
wargear.text: One unit in your army with the Character special rule that does not have the Unique keyword and no other Relic Wargear may purchase this wargear. A model with this Relic Wargear increases their Fear (x) special rule to Fear (3).

wargear.name: Mirage Field
wargear.text: This model may not be targeted for attacks unless the attacking model is within 6". In addition, friendly Eldar units within 12" of the Webway Gate receive the benefit of Light Cover. If they are already benefiting from Light Cover, they gain the Benefit of Heavy Cover instead.
